title: MDES Customer Service release notes, July 2026
notes: Initial version 2026-06-29, dates updated 2026-07-07, version history added 2026-08-07; MTF 2026-07-29, production 2026-08-05, available globally. Change 1 introduces Token Spend Control APIs (search, create, update, delete) that let issuers enabled for the Mastercard Virtual Card Token and Mastercard Agent Pay programs set token-level spend limits (daily, weekly, monthly, per transaction, single use, absolute) and allow or block lists (MCC, merchant ID, transaction category code, transaction type, geography); Mastercard declines tokenized transactions that break the rules.

title: Trust for agentic commerce: Powering secure value exchange in a world where AI agents shop, pay and act on our behalf
notes: 16-page PDF dated September 2026 (PDF created 2026-09-24, Last-Modified 2026-09-29), offered from the landing page that the mastercard.com copy of the 2026-09-30 release links as Mastercard's Agent Pay Trust Framework. mastercard.com refuses curl; the PDF was fetched inside a headed Chrome session on 2026-10-21. Describes five capabilities (identity, intent, controls, trusted execution, intelligence), introduces the Agent Pay Ready mark for participants that meet Agent Pay program requirements, and lists the offerings behind the framework, including Agentic Disputes and Agent Pay for Machines with verifiable promise-to-pay artifacts. It gives no technical specification, Agent Pay volume, pricing or liability rule; its market figures are third-party projections (ICSC and McKinsey, Gartner).
